mechanism_evidence.claim: During an in-progress multi-source search, the coordinator sends newly found books through deltaResults while leaving results empty until finished.
The change-source callback updates changeSourceResults only from progress.results and never consumes progress.deltaResults, so intermediate candidates are ignored while only status updates advance.
After coordinator.search resolves, ReadBook.ets assigns the final returned results to changeSourceResults, which explains why candidates appear only after all sources finish.
